description: Implementation of the rlc_rx_am_entity class, which manages the reception and processing of RLC Acknowledged Mode (AM) PDUs, including handling control and data PDUs, reassembly of SDUs, and status reporting within a radio communication protocol stack.

classes.name: rlc_rx_am_entity
classes.description: Handles reception, reassembly, and status reporting for RLC AM PDUs in a radio protocol stack.

methods.name: handle_pdu
methods.description: Processes incoming PDUs, distinguishing between control and data PDUs.

methods.name: handle_control_pdu
methods.description: Handles control PDUs, specifically status PDUs.

methods.name: handle_data_pdu
methods.description: Processes data PDUs, including header parsing, SDU reassembly, and window management.

methods.name: handle_full_data_sdu
methods.description: Handles complete SDUs received as full SDU PDUs.

methods.name: handle_segment_data_sdu
methods.description: Handles SDU segments received as part of segmented SDUs.

methods.name: store_segment
methods.description: Stores and manages overlapping or contiguous SDU segments.

methods.name: update_segment_inventory
methods.description: Updates the reception status of SDU segments, detecting gaps and completeness.

methods.name: reassemble_sdu
methods.description: Reassembles complete SDUs from stored segments or full SDU slices.

methods.name: refresh_status_report
methods.description: Generates and updates the status report (ACK/NACK) for the received SDUs.

methods.name: store_status_report
methods.description: Stores the current status report for transmission.

methods.name: get_status_pdu
methods.description: Retrieves the current status PDU, triggering timers and synchronization.

methods.name: get_status_pdu_length
methods.description: Returns the length of the current status PDU.

methods.name: status_report_required
methods.description: Checks if a status report needs to be sent.

methods.name: notify_status_report_changed
methods.description: Notifies the upper layer that the status report has changed.

methods.name: on_expired_status_prohibit_timer
methods.description: Handles expiration of the status prohibit timer, triggering status report transmission.

methods.name: on_expired_reassembly_timer
methods.description: Handles expiration of the reassembly timer, updating window status and triggering reassembly.
